title: Power Automate: Credentials - Integration with Delinea secret server
description: Power Automate will support Delinea Secret Server as an external credential provider for desktop flows. Organizations can securely use credentials managed in Delinea for machine sign-in and credential retrieval during attended and unattended automation.
